---
title: "Francesco's"
author: "Francesco Pipitone"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#install.packages("shiny","leaflet")
library(leaflet)

mappa <- leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(lat = 41.89846,
             lng = 12.48929,
             popup = "Where Francesco works")

#install.packages("htmlwidgets")
library(htmlwidgets)
saveWidget(mappa, "index.html", selfcontained = TRUE)


```
